scenario: LSER.19.8 / LSER.16.2 — `mean` returns `Float?`, so emitting `t.mean` into a non-nullable `avg: Float` slot is a concrete-value position holding an unnarrowed `T?` ([LNUL.5.1]) and is refused with DS_VALIDATE_NULLABLE_UNNARROWED. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s `lser_19_8_cold_nullability`, which gives `mean` a nullable type, and `lnul_5_1_concrete`, which refuses it at the slot. Positive half: LSER.19.8_nullable_agg_rescued.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    avg: Float mutable

series Reading.v:
    mean sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Reading t
->
    emit Out logical k: "x" avg: t.mean
